== Image injection

* Fixed an issue where installing an Android app with *Instrument application for camera injection* enabled failed with a `Failed to instrument` error when the app was built with R8 code optimization.
* Improved image injection for instrumented Android apps that use Camera2. Camera frames and captured images now receive the injected image.
* Instrumentation now stops and displays an error message that names the app's file format when an app uses method handles. Kobiton cannot instrument these apps.
